source.generator: new independently salted noisy two-error public-key automaton with equal 1-bit edge noise on positives and negatives; validity requires consistent flipped bit index across two distinct hops, not exact key continuation
source.positive_label: unique route to target with exactly two separate transitions of raw16 Hamming distance1, same differing bit position on both; all other steps Hamming distance0
source.negative_label: same route topology, exactly 2 raw16 Hamming distance1 transitions but different differing bit positions; pair made via off-role donor swap preserving global src/dst token multiset

models.historical_fitted_weights: F124O original plus source-authenticated FIT-fitted U; unchanged
models.selector: Original F124Z destination-diverse, original 7 active plus 9 retained cell records

controls.fixed_exact16: F124AF bounded exact-key continuation, unchanged Python bytecode except public validator substitution
controls.fixed_tolerant15: new preregistered deterministic Hamming distance<=1 comparator, 7 active/9 retained with original node/raw16/score slots; ignores noise consistency and is expected to flag both labels
controls.fixed_consistency16: new preregistered role/edge traversal, 7 active/9 retained original 3-field persistent cells, accumulate first noisy bit index only in existing scalar score field; require second noisy bit index identical, reject third; uses no source family, label, target oracle or pretrained parameters
controls.strong_H12: Original F124H bytecode fixed, original traversal 128 cap unchanged; must complete>=46/48 source pairs else blocked
controls.semantic_reference: independent full state-space semantic oracle evaluator-only; not a fair model/control
